Select IC50 activity rows for human ATP-dependent translocase ABCB1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Join docs to capture pubmed_id and doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target name 'ATP-dependent translocase ABCB1' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50'. Filter to keep only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null). Return columns: compound_chembl_id (aliased from chembl_id), canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
